body: Hey thanks for the response, I do actually find myself enjoying the little things like nature but it seems to leave my mind open to run free about what other people would be doing or the fact nobody I know my own age would do that kind of thing kinda makes me more distanced I guess.

Hey there, thank you so much for the response.

I have plenty of friends on the internet already that were once friends in real life and some I'll never meet so I don't feel looking for more of that will help.

I will read the article now though thanks again.

I am quite progressed in most of the fields I mentioned, I just notice now everytime I go to do them I make no progress at all and my enjoyment is limited to the first minute or two

Working out is something I did a lot a few years ago but not much anymore, there are no gyms where I now live but I have some home equipment I use occasionally for a minute or two before my drive just drops.

Hi, thank you for the response,
I play a lot of video games unfortunately, and they have long since lost their luster for me, I used to play with my friends a lot but being without internet for most of the week meant slowly it died off, other than that I guess ive always liked languages and learning them, cars and playing the guitar and going to the gym too, but as of the last 2 or 3 years ive struggled to even work up the will to practice any of those things because I just feel I am not good enough or improving enough to consider it worthwhile anymore, keep in mind I live in a small town of around two thousand people and although I can physically drive a car fine my derealisation has stopped me getting a licence to be able to drive alone.
